name: Bhagwan Ram
quote: The seventh avatar of Vishnu; Prince of Ayodhya, revered as maryada purushottama, the ideal man.

name: Sita
quote: Daughter of King Janak and Rama's wife, an incarnation of Lakshmi celebrated for her devotion and inner strength.

name: Lakshman
quote: Rama's devoted younger brother, who chose fourteen years of exile at his side.

name: Bharat
quote: Rama's brother, who ruled Ayodhya as regent and placed Rama's sandals on the throne in his stead.

name: Shatrughna
quote: The youngest of the four royal brothers, twin of Lakshman and loyal supporter of Bharat.

name: Hanuman
quote: Vanara devotee whose boundless devotion to Rama and heroic leap to Lanka made him a symbol of selfless service.

name: Urmila
quote: Lakshman's wife, remembered for her quiet sacrifice while he accompanied Rama into exile.

name: Shabari
quote: A humble devotee who waited a lifetime in the forest for the chance to offer Rama her berries.

name: Jatayu
quote: The aged vulture king who gave his life fighting Ravana in an attempt to save Sita.

name: Bhagwan Krishna
quote: The eighth avatar of Vishnu; Arjun's charioteer and guide, whose counsel on the battlefield became the Bhagavad Gita.

name: Draupadi
quote: Wife of the five Pandavas, whose humiliation in the Kaurava court became a turning point of the epic.

name: Arjun
quote: The third Pandava, a peerless archer and the direct recipient of Krishna's teachings.

name: Yudhishthir
quote: Eldest Pandava and king, called Dharmaraja for his unwavering commitment to truth.

name: Bhishma
quote: The grand patriarch who took a lifelong vow of celibacy and could choose the moment of his own death.

name: Vidur
quote: The wise and impartial minister of Hastinapur, remembered for his integrity and counsel.

name: Abhimanyu
quote: Arjun's son, who bravely broke into the Chakravyuha formation but could not find his way out.

name: Ekalavya
quote: A self-taught archer who famously gave his thumb as guru-dakshina to Dronacharya.

name: Maharishi Vashisht
quote: The royal sage and guru of the Raghu dynasty, including Rama.

name: Maharishi Ved Vyas
quote: The sage credited with compiling the Mahabharata and organizing the Vedas.

name: Prahlad
quote: A young devotee of Vishnu whose unshakeable faith survived every trial his father put him through.

name: Dhruv
quote: A child whose determined penance to Vishnu earned him a place as the eternal pole star.

name: Nachiketa
quote: A boy from the Katha Upanishad whose questions to Yama, the god of death, revealed the nature of the eternal Self.

name: Raja Janak
quote: The philosopher-king of Mithila and Sita's father, revered for ruling while remaining spiritually detached.

name: Savitri
quote: A devoted wife whose wit and resolve won her husband Satyavan's life back from Yama.

name: Gargi
quote: A Vedic philosopher renowned for boldly questioning the sage Yajnavalkya in the court of King Janak.

name: Namdev
quote: A 13th-century poet-saint and contemporary of Sant Gyaneshwar, whose devotional verses to Vitthal are also included in the Guru Granth Sahib.

name: Ambarish Raja
quote: A devoted king whose unwavering faith and humility, even under a sage's curse, showed the protective power of surrender to God.

name: Adi Shankaracharya
quote: An 8th-century philosopher who traveled across India establishing four mathas and systematizing Advaita Vedanta.

name: Ramanujacharya
quote: An 11th-century philosopher-saint who founded Vishishtadvaita, the philosophy of qualified non-dualism.

name: Madhvacharya
quote: A 13th-century philosopher who founded Dvaita, the school of dualistic Vedanta.

name: Nimbarkacharya
quote: A philosopher-saint who founded Dvaitadvaita, teaching simultaneous oneness and difference with the divine.

name: Vallabhacharya
quote: The philosopher-saint who founded the Pushtimarg tradition of devotion to Krishna.

name: Kunti
quote: Mother of the Pandavas, revered for her unwavering devotion and resilience through a lifetime of hardship.

name: Ramakrishna Paramahansa
quote: A 19th-century mystic whose God-realization across faiths inspired a generation of seekers.

name: Swami Vivekananda
quote: Ramakrishna's disciple, who introduced Vedanta to the world at Chicago's 1893 Parliament of Religions.

name: Sant Kabir
quote: A 15th-century poet-saint whose dohas cut across caste and creed to point directly at the divine.

name: Sant Tukaram
quote: When our perspective remains positive, even humiliation loses its power.

name: Sant Gyanneshwar
quote: A 13th-century saint who wrote the Dnyaneshwari, a celebrated commentary on the Bhagavad Gita, in his teens.

name: Sant Ravidas
quote: A poet-saint whose verses on equality and devotion transcended the caste barriers of his time.

name: Sant Tulsidas
quote: Author of the Ramcharitmanas, which brought the story of Rama to millions in the language of the people.

name: Sant Surdas
quote: A blind poet-saint whose verses on Krishna's childhood remain central to Krishna bhakti.

name: Narsinh Mehta
quote: A Gujarati poet-saint whose bhajans, including "Vaishnav Jan To", celebrate compassion and devotion.

name: Guru Nanak Dev
quote: Founder of Sikhism, who taught one formless God and the equality of all people.

name: Samarth Ramdas
quote: A saint and spiritual guide to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, author of the Dasbodh.

name: Meera Bai
quote: A Rajput princess whose passionate devotional songs to Krishna made her one of India's best-loved poet-saints.

name: Mata Sharda Devi
quote: Spiritual companion of Ramakrishna Paramahansa, revered in her own right as the Holy Mother.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj
quote: Founder of the Maratha Empire, celebrated for his statecraft and swarajya, or self-rule.

name: Maharana Pratap
quote: The Rajput king of Mewar, remembered for his defiance against Mughal rule and devotion to his homeland.

name: Rani Lakshmibai
quote: The Rani of Jhansi, whose courage leading her army in 1857 made her an icon of resistance.

name: Emperor Ashoka
quote: The Mauryan emperor who, after the Kalinga war, embraced Buddhism and ruled through dhamma.

name: Chandragupta Maurya
quote: Founder of the Maurya Empire, guided by his mentor Chanakya to unify much of the Indian subcontinent.

name: Chanakya
quote: When purpose is greater than self, no insult, hardship, or limitation can stop you.

name: Aryabhata
quote: The 5th-century mathematician-astronomer who calculated pi and explained the rotation of the Earth.

name: Kalidasa
quote: Classical India's greatest poet-dramatist, author of Shakuntala and Meghaduta.

name: Sushruta
quote: The ancient physician regarded as the father of surgery, author of the Sushruta Samhita.

name: Charaka
quote: The physician-scholar whose Charaka Samhita is a foundational text of Ayurveda.

name: Rabindranath Tagore
quote: Poet and philosopher, the first non-European Nobel laureate in Literature, for Gitanjali.
